brief: The canvas displays complex, luminous geometric pathways forming a dense network of interwoven lines. At every intersection point, the pathways give way to sharply defined, vibrant crystalline veins of varying colors, suggesting mineral deposits. The veins subtly pulse and grow over time, giving the impression of slow geological crystallization. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, a new, branching vein instantly grows outward from the cursor's location, momentarily strengthening the connection and causing the surrounding crystals to flash brightly before settling back into their slow, continuous growth pattern.

statement: This sketch creates a geological visualization of crystallizing mineral formations. Through flowing geometric threads that weave across the canvas, it depicts the slow, patient process of underground crystal growth. The system begins with a network of luminous pathways that gradually extend and branch, forming an intricate underground web. At every intersection point, vibrant crystalline formations emerge—these crystals pulse and grow over time, suggesting mineral deposits slowly taking shape. When clicked, users trigger new branching veins that instantly radiate from their cursor position, causing nearby crystals to flash brightly before returning to their natural growth rhythm. The work captures the patient, almost meditative process of geological formation through a blend of organic flowing lines and sharp, structured crystalline forms.
